checks.description: every reference-shaped (tag@attr) pair in 4000 corpus files carries a ruling (149 pairs, 127913 occurrences)
all 38 claimed carriers emit an edge whose target carries the probe's marker
all 2 carriers that hold only under a condition emit an edge when that condition is met

limitations.description: the corpus walk consults neither the analyzer's carrier table nor the differential oracle's, which is the point: a differential cannot contradict a premise it shares. What it CANNOT do is rule on whether a pair should be a carrier — that judgement is a human decision, so an unreviewed pair fails here and must be ruled in RULED_NOT_A_CARRIER or added as a rule

looksLikeReference is deliberately generous and errs toward asking, because a false candidate costs one line of ruling while a missed carrier is an absent dependency nobody reports. The 61 pairs include presentation, framework-binding and data-* attributes ruled as non-carriers

the corpus is the pinned fixtures repositories and rotates as a pool; the census reports what those files contain, not what the HTML specification permits, so a carrier that no corpus exercises is outside its reach and is covered only by CARRIER_PROBES
